services.name: Clay Classes
services.desc: Clay Creations: A Comprehensive Ceramics ClassTuesdays, July 7 - August 18 from 12:30 to 3:30pm In this six week class, ceramic artist Madison O’Keefe will guide students in a creative exploration of clay. This class is for adult students (ages 18+) with little to no experience in ceramics. Students will learn foundational hand building skills such as pinch, coil and slab, surface decoration, wheel throwing basics, as well as important ceramics terminology and glazing techniques. Students will typically complete around 8-10 pieces to glaze and fire. Students will have the opportunity for open studio time during Foundry open hours if needed. services.name: Exhibitions Archive
services.desc: The Foundry Art Centre hosts exhibitions of student artwork from across the region. Over 300 schools have displayed their students’ work in the Baue Family Children’s Gallery, showcasing the talent of thousands of young artists. If you are a teacher interested in having an exhibition at the Foundry, please complete the form below and we’ll be in touch with you. Exhibitions are one-month long, running from September - May. When we receive your completed form, we will contact you about a timeline for your exhibition. Questions? Email Christine Tavares at ctavares@foundryartcentre.org The Foundry Art Centre is a division of the Greater Saint Charles Convention & Visitors BureauDISCOVER SAINT

services.desc: Information about renting space from the Foundry Art Centre for weddings and events. The Foundry Art Centre offers event spaces filled with creativity. Let our team help you create an unparalleled experience for you and your guests. Located along the Missouri River and Katy Trail in downtown Saint Charles, the Foundry Art Centre is a space for art creation, exhibitions, and special events. The beautifully redesigned interior of The Foundry, where railroad cars were once produced, is now a cultural center for the region featuring local, regional, national, and international art.
